summary: Eight metre kerb on a busy arterial, dwellings 12 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 12 m away at both ends of the stretch, more behind.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is next to a wide through road; stretch is under a van length plus margin.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with some cars parked on the far side.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the opposite kerb, but not on this side.

sun_shade: Tree canopy over the verge, shading from the east and south.

best_section.where: Carmody Road east kerb, beside the planted verge
